newsitem.title: ITALY: Texas Pacific has 51 pct stake in Italy's Ducati.
newsitem.headline: Texas Pacific has 51 pct stake in Italy's Ducati.

text.p: Ducati Motor SpA, a new joint venture company formed by the Castiglioni family and a group of investors led by Texas Pacific Group, has bought all the assets of motorcycle firm Ducati from the Cagiva group, which was itself owned by the Castiglioni brothers, a Ducati statement said.
A Ducati source said the total value of the deal was around 500 billion lire.
The source said the Castiglioni family keeps a 49 percent stake in Ducati Motor with an option to buy a further two percent. Texas Group investors hold the remaining 51 percent.
Two Cagiva group marketing companies, Cagiva Trading and Cagiva North America, have also joined the Ducati Motor joint venture, the source added.
Texas Pacific Group runs TPG Partners of Fort Worth, a $720 million investment fund.
